annotations.title: Evaluate Relay Downgrade Risk & Session Endurance

description: Evaluates LLM rate-card tiers to quantify relay downgrade risk, cost ratios, and remaining coding session turns. Deterministic in-memory calculation requiring no API keys; unknown model IDs safely fall back to the flagship baseline without error. Sums burned_usd and remaining_usd into the total session pool and projects remaining turns against a $137.45 reference budget, returning cost ratios, an endurance matrix, and a recommended production model ID. Use this tool when comparing session burn rates or suspected relay throttling; use reconcile_usage_receipt for single invoice lines, check_context_cliff for prompt-length surcharges, or optimize_prompt_cache_layout for mid-prompt cache breakpoint fixes.

burned_usd.description: Cumulative USD quota spent in the current coding session.

model.description: Canonical provider/model ID to evaluate (e.g. 'openai/gpt-6-astra' or 'openai/gpt-6.1-sol').

remaining_usd.description: Remaining USD quota balance; combined with burned_usd to derive initial pool size.

name: detect_model_downgrade_and_substitution
